purpose: Implementation and browser acceptance checklist; not an executable runtime contract
dataBoundary: Synthetic employee and assigned synthetic customers only

stages.title: 客户洞察
stages.hostResponsibility: Resolve employee adoption owner and authorized customer; never derive permission from model output
stages.deliverable: Selected customer, visit objective, risk information and explicit missing information
stages.gap: Verified employee binding and customer selection in the managed Builder path

stages.title: 事实汇集
stages.hostResponsibility: Preserve source receipts and source data dates; retain facts if model explanation fails
stages.deliverable: Authorized profile and holdings; cashflow only when separately bound and authorized
stages.gap: Managed assembly, evidence presentation and optional cashflow binding

stages.title: 服务建议
stages.hostResponsibility: Only policy-approved eligibleProducts can support product discussion; no purchase or trading
stages.deliverable: Evidence-backed talking points, product conditions if available, and questions to verify
stages.gap: Allocation adapter implemented in the candidate branch; managed identity wiring, live authorization and browser validation remain pending

stages.title: 经理复核
stages.existingAsset: Employee Agent create_customer_followup_task approval and execution receipt
stages.hostResponsibility: Record human review and reason; require explicit approval for followup writeback
stages.deliverable: Reviewed previsit report; followup receipt only after confirmed execution
stages.gap: Review persistence and managed approval wiring; synthetic CRM writeback readiness must be verified
